title: S&P Global Investment Manager Index (Nov 2026) — 10:00 ET on CPI day, the dirtiest slot the series has had in this calendar
source: EST: DERIVED BY THE SAME RULE, AND FILED SO THE RULE'S SECOND FORWARD USE IS ON THE RECORD. S&P Global's PMI calendar (pmi.spglobal.com/Public/Release/ReleaseDates?language=en, fetched direct 2026-09-09, HTTP 200, 23,858 bytes) is a rolling ~4-week window running 'September 11' to 'October 07' today, so November cannot be read from it and will not be readable until roughly 2026-10-13. The rule — the Tuesday eight days after the month's first Monday — now stands 7 for 7 across six primary mastheads (2024-03-12, 2025-10-14, 2026-01-13, 2026-05-12, 2026-06-09, 2026-08-11) and one listing (2026-09-15), three of those mastheads fetched direct by the sp-global-investment-manager-index-2026-10-13 lane on 2026-09-09. November 2026's first Monday is 2026-11-02, giving 2026-11-10; 15:00 UTC = 10:00 ET, since US DST ends 2026-11-01 and the masthead time is stated in local ET on every edition read (1000 EST or 1000 EDT). Proposed by the never-assessed initial research of sp-global-investment-manager-index-2026-10-13, 2026-09-09. Estimate for the same single honest reason as its parent: no publisher statement of this date exists.
notes: PROPOSED FOR THE ATTRIBUTION LADDER, NOT FOR THE PRINT. Three consecutive editions give this calendar three different measurement conditions on the same 10:00 ET release, and that is the reason to carry all three: SEPTEMBER 2026-09-15 is the clean window (nothing else tracked in the 10:00 hour); OCTOBER 2026-10-13 shares the slot with existing-home-sales-2026-10-13, a co-tenant its own ledger measures inert on 114 release days (SPY p=0.66); NOVEMBER 2026-11-10 lands on cpi-2026-11-10 — a high-impact 08:30 print 90 minutes earlier — alongside treasury-10y-note-2026-11-10 and us-china-tariff-truce-expiry-2026-11-10. A November null therefore means nothing at all, and a November move is CPI's until proven otherwise. Read that as a reason to score the tape question in September and October and to stop, not as a reason to watch November's tape. NOT A TRADE: symbols is empty, no macro-keyed house playbook, no published consensus for a sentiment survey, status is estimate. If the October listing appears on any date other than 2026-10-13, this proposal is derived from a broken rule and should be corrected by whoever finds it.
